# The Network DNA

> > Technical blog covering enterprise networking, datacenter technologies, and security with deep dives into Cisco DNA Center, SD-Access, ACI, MPLS, BGP, and VMware virtualization.

The Network DNA is a comprehensive resource for network engineers and IT professionals, focusing on Cisco enterprise solutions (SD-Access, ACI, ASR routers, Nexus switching), routing protocols (BGP, MPLS), datacenter architectures (vPC, FEX, VXLAN), VMware virtualization, and network security topics. The blog provides practical configuration guides, architectural explanations, and troubleshooting tips.

## Key Topics

- Cisco SD-Access
- Cisco DNA Center
- Cisco ACI (Application Centric Infrastructure)
- BGP (Border Gateway Protocol)
- MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching)
- VXLAN overlay networks
- Datacenter networking
- Nexus switching and vPC
- VMware vSphere virtualization
- Network security
- Fabric Edge
- FEX (Fabric Extenders)
- LACP and link aggregation
- DHCP Snooping
- DNS tunneling prevention

- [Multicast PIM-ASM & Cisco SD-Access](https://www.thenetworkdna.com/2019/01/multicast-pim-asm-cisco-sd-access.html): PIM-ASM multicast in Cisco SD-Access fabric with VXLAN overlay
- [Quick points about Wireless in Cisco SD-Access](https://www.thenetworkdna.com/2019/01/quick-points-about-wireless-in-cisco-sd.html): Wireless integration in Cisco SD-Access: WLC deployment & fabric policy

- [Basics about Cisco ACI GOLF L3Out](https://www.thenetworkdna.com/2019/05/basics-about-cisco-aci-golf-l3out.html): Cisco ACI GOLF L3Out basics: BGP EVPN & WAN connectivity via spine
